title: Sheinbaum Rejects DEA Chief's Claim of 'Deadly Connection' Between Her Government and Cartels
detail: President Claudia Sheinbaum publicly rejected a claim by the head of the US Drug Enforcement Administration that there is a 'deadly connection' between her government and Mexican criminal cartels. Speaking at her daily morning press conference (mañanera), Sheinbaum characterized the DEA chief's remarks as 'more like a political statement than one backed by evidence.' The exchange added to a string of friction points in the US-Mexico relationship in July 2026, alongside the stalled USMCA renewal, tariff threats, and Mexico's push for criminal charges over ICE-related deaths of Mexican nationals.

media.caption: President Sheinbaum dismisses DEA chief's claim of a 'deadly connection' between her government and cartels
